scope: Protect authored and legacy relative /media/<asset-id> references in renderer-supported page content; cover image, card, gallery, video poster and legacy video/audio sources, and avoid successful-run screenshot artifact storage.

finding.reproduction: The public renderer accepts safe internal URL values in versioned authored image/video/audio sources, video posters, normalized Card imageSrc, authored Gallery/Carousel item src, and normalized structured Gallery/Carousel item src. The reference scan only matched explicit assetId fields. A published internal URL could therefore be omitted from usage/archive checks and public media authorization. The legacy sanci-document adapter also renders contentVersion-free image.src, video/audio.src, and video.poster values; the first authored-only pass missed that renderer path.
finding.fix: Recognize only an exact relative /media/<MEDIA_ASSET_ID> pathname (allowing the renderer's trailing slash normalization and query string). Apply renderer-specific version, node type, media MIME, Media Library ID override, Card normalization, Gallery/Carousel 40-item bounds, and normalized structured-content checks before a URL-backed reference authorizes public access. The exact URL authorizer now accepts both authored v1 and metadata-free legacy media nodes while preserving MIME and Media Library ID precedence.
regressions: A published model containing direct image src, Card imageSrc, authored Gallery items[0].src, structured Gallery contentModel.items[0].src, and video poster URLs reports all five references.
An active internal URL reference prevents media archival with HTTP 409.
The published media route returns the exact local R2 fixture bytes for a referenced internal URL.
Editor screenshots upload only after the complete Editor Core job fails, after every required check, with a 7-day retention window.
The active-plan audit continues to upload only its bounded text artifact with a 30-day retention window.
A legacy sanci-document Image src and Video poster remain visible usage references and authorize the exact local fixture bytes; a Media Library ID override continues to deny the stale URL.
Legacy sanci-document Video src and Audio src internal URLs are reported by usage, block archive with HTTP 409, and authorize exact matching local WebM/WAV fixture bytes.
